messages:
sarah: Heads-up: unexpected schema mismatch surfaced in EU edge logs. Propose a fast-window tonight 21:30-22:15 UTC to apply hotfix and staged pin across API/runtime/router/console.

mike: Whatxactly is failing? Any user-visible errors?

sarah: Some inference requests hitting the EU edge with header `X-Schema: v2` are getting field-drop errors downstream (runtime v3.9 expects v2.opt). Not widespread but affects high-value clients.

jordan: Console shows a trace: UI sends batch with new field `user_meta` but API strips it due to schema mismatch. We can toggle console to limit v2 propagation while fix rolls. Flag: `console.limit_schema_v2`.

lee: Router can do quick regional steering. Plan: shift 80% EU traffic to fallback pool that pins runtime v3.8 and API commit sha `b7f4e2`. Keep 20% on current to monitor.

deploy-bot: preflight: CI green, infra quotas OK, canary pool available. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/4902 (schema patch), https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/133 (hotfix build).

mike: I'll produce a pinned variant: runtime `v3.9.1-hotfix-pin` pointing to build with schema compatibility layer disabled. Fallback will be `v3.8-stable`.

sarah: Rollout steps: 1) enable console.limit_schema_v2=true for EU orgs list 2) router weight shift -> fallback pool 80% 3) deploy runtime pin to fallback pool 4) deploy API patch to canary 5) monitor 20m then full revert of router if stable.

jordan: I'll prepare the console PR and a short migration note for support: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/910.

lee: Router commands for ops: `router shift --region eu-central --target fallback --pct 80 --reason "schema-hotfix"` and to rollback: `router shift --target default --pct 100`.

mike: Rollback checklist in case of regression: a) revert router shift b) unpin runtime c) revert API patch commit via tag `api-vX` d) set console.limit_schema_v2=false e) flush edge caches for header routing `edgectl purge --match X-Schema=v2`.

sarah: SLA note: we expect up to 30s tail for pinned pool priming. Notify sales & support. I'll draft a short blurb.

deploy-bot: orchestration starting at 21:30 UTC. Canary region: eu-central-1. Targets: runtime=v3.9.1-hotfix-pin (fallback), api=patch/4902 (canary), console flag on for EU orgs.

ops-bot: quiet window scheduled 21:20-22:30 UTC. Oncall rota: mike (primary), lee (secondary).

sarah: Everyone ack ownership? Please react.

lee: :thumbsup: Ill run router shift and stand by for rollback.

mike: :thumbsup: Deploying runtime pin and watching tail latencies.

jordan: :thumbsup: Console PR merged and flag toggled for EU canary list.

deploy-bot: router shift applied -> 80% fallback. Runtime pinning applied to fallback pool. API canary deployed to 20%. Metrics link: https://grafana.redwood/d/serve/eu-hotfix-1722.

mike: Seeing increased calls to fallback but latencies OK. Error spikes dropped for affected traces.

jordan: Console traces show reduced `user_meta` drops. Good.

lee: Holding 20m. If no error reappearance, we will gradually restore weights and then remove pin.

sarah: After 20m hold, proceed to restore traffic to 100% and then roll forward API patch. If any 5xx or error rate >0.6% return to rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: hold complete, restoring weights in 3...2... applied -> 100% default pool. Post-checks running.

mike: Post-restore: tail error 0.05% and latency steady. No rollback needed.

jordan: Confirmed console migration stable.

sarah: Closing window. I'll file release-note: "hotfix: EU schema compatibility, runtime pinning, API patch; temporary console limit flag" and tag PRs. Archive notes under /releases/hotfixs/2026-03-eu-schema.json.

ops-bot: orchestration finished successfully. Quiet window end 22:30 UTC.

sarah: Thanks team. If any regressions overnight follow the rollback checklist above and reopen this thread.
